Destroy the four [[Stygian Lord]]s<!-- to finish off the [[-->.

===Objectives===
* Journey into the trenches of the [[Stygian Veil]] and kill the [[Stygian Lord]]s. 4...0 of 4 still remaining.
* See [[Adept of Whispers (Stygian Veil)|Adept of Whispers]] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 10,000 [[Experience]]
* 800 [[Gold]]
* 800 [[Lightbringer Promotion Points]]

==Walkthrough==
The four [[Stygian Lord]]s are each at a different place in the area. Each trench has a few hidden spawns that will ambush the party. Upon entering any trench and getting near the half-way point, a large spawn of melee creatures will appear at either end of the trench and then run to the opposite side (sandwiching whoever is inside). Also, one or two Tormentor demons will spawn on the two cliffs overlooking the trench. It's recommended that the party have someone go in and trigger this spawn first before they enter the trench. This player can either just die in there and get [[Rebirth|Rebirthed]] from the cliff above or they can use a teleportation skill like [[Recall]] to return to their party members.

The Stygian Lords on the map are as follows:

* A monk with a stationary group of Tormentor demons as well as a hidden spawn of the Stygian creatures that will appear upon entering the alcove he is found in.
* An elementalist with a large hidden spawn in the alcove he is found in.
* A mesmer with a stationary group of Tormentor creatures and a few hidden [[Torment Claw]]s.
* A necromancer with a stationary group of Tormentor creatures.

The party should pay attention to the patrols roaming near each boss, especially in the case of the elementalist, as one patrol can come from behind the party and surprise them.

After taking the reward for the quest, six [[Smothering Tendrils]] will appear and the [[Dreadspawn Maw]] will open. Make sure, before taking the reward, that the area with the large maw is clear and that all party members clear are up by the Adept of Whispers so they do not get killed by the Tendrils' special attack. Killing each of the Tendrils will spawn a group of [[Torment Claw]]s and Stygian creatures.

Killing the Dreadspawn Maw spawns a [[Stygian Chest]] and progresses the quest [[Mallyx the Unyielding (quest)|Mallyx the Unyielding]]. See there for a walkthrough.
